Definition: something prepared, i.e. a sacrificial wafer
BiblicalUsage: Kavvan means a cake, a sacrificial wafer. Jeremiah 7:18 says the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and Jeremiah 44:19 has the people admitting they made her cakes to worship her.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a cake baked for a false god is still idolatry, even when the whole family helps make it.
